inventory.visualPurpose: The phosphodiesterase-inhibitors block's own printed set (the section's sole visual element — the four-column TYPE OF INHIBITOR/MECHANISM OF ACTION/CLINICAL USES/ADVERSE EFFECTS class table of five rows, plus the two categorizing footnotes)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: ONE FOUR-COLUMN TEXT TABLE + TWO FOOTNOTES (PURE TEXT — ZERO rasters on pdf 267; pdfimages returns no rows; COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced as artwork). Header: 'Phosphodiesterase inhibitors' + the intro sentence 'Phosphodiesterase (PDE) inhibitors inhibit PDE, which catalyzes the hydrolysis of cAMP and/or cGMP, and thereby increase cAMP and/or cGMP. These inhibitors have varying specificity for PDE isoforms and thus have different clinical uses.' Rows (TYPE / MECHANISM / USES / ADVERSE): 'Nonspecific PDE inhibitor / Theophylline': '↓ cAMP hydrolysis → ↑ cAMP → bronchial smooth muscle relaxation → bronchodilation' | 'COPD/asthma (rarely used)' | 'Cardiotoxicity (eg, tachycardia, arrhythmia), neurotoxicity (eg, seizures, headache), abdominal pain'. 'PDE-5 inhibitors / Sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil, avanafil': '↓ hydrolysis of cGMP → ↑ cGMP → ↑ smooth muscle relaxation by enhancing NO activity → pulmonary vasodilation and ↑ blood flow in corpus cavernosum fills the penis' | 'Erectile dysfunction / Pulmonary hypertension / Benign prostatic hyperplasia (tadalafil only)' | 'Facial flushing, headache, dyspepsia, hypotension in patients taking nitrates; "hot and sweaty," then headache, heartburn, hypotension' + 'Sildenafil only: cyanopia (blue-tinted vision) via inhibition of PDE-6 (six) in retina'. 'PDE-4 inhibitor / Roflumilast': '↑ cAMP in neutrophils, granulocytes, and bronchial epithelium' | 'Severe COPD' | 'Abdominal pain, weight loss, depression, anxiety, insomnia'. 'PDE-3 inhibitor / Milrinone': 'In cardiomyocytes: ↑ cAMP → ↑ Ca2+ influx → ↑ ionotropy and chronotropy / In vascular smooth muscle: ↑ cAMP → MLCK inhibition → vasodilation → ↓ preload and afterload' | 'Acute decompensated HF with cardiogenic shock (inotrope)' | 'Tachycardia, ventricular arrhythmias, hypotension'. '"Platelet inhibitors" / Cilostazol^a / Dipyridamole^b': 'In platelets: ↑ cAMP → inhibition of platelet aggregation' | 'Intermittent claudication / Stroke or TIA prevention (with aspirin) / Cardiac stress testing (dipyridamole only, due to coronary vasodilation) / Prevention of coronary stent restenosis' | 'Nausea, headache, facial flushing, hypotension, abdominal pain'. Footnotes: a 'Cilostazol is a PDE-3 inhibitor, but due to its indications is categorized as a platelet inhibitor together with dipyridamole.'; b 'Dipyridamole is a nonspecific PDE inhibitor, leading to inhibition of platelet aggregation. It also prevents adenosine reuptake by platelets → ↑ extracellular adenosine → ↑ vasodilation.' Carried VERBATIM as the note's two table blocks and conveyed as ONE original KYP isoform-fork map (the mechanism strip, the isoform fork cards, the nonspecific pair, the use grid, the caution strip, the boundary strip, the reading-rule footer) — no artwork reproduced.

The set is carried VERBATIM as the note's two table blocks (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION — every type, mechanism, use, and adverse cell is the book's own print, including the 'COPD/asthma (rarely used)' rank, the '(tadalafil only)' parenthetical, the '(dipyridamole only, due to coronary vasodilation)' clause, the 'hypotension in patients taking nitrates' token, the '"hot and sweaty,"' quote, the book's own 'ionotropy' spelling, and its own '(six)' parenthetical of 'PDE-6 (six) in retina') and conveyed as ONE original KYP isoform-fork map in the registry visual PdeInhibitorMap (THE MECHANISM STRIP — PDE catalyzes the hydrolysis of cAMP and/or cGMP; inhibit PDE → ↑ cAMP and/or ↑ cGMP; the currency rows print on book 237 [Gs → adenylyl cyclase → ATP → Cyclic AMP] — the camp split [cAMP vs cGMP] is KYP's; THE ISOFORM FORK CARDS — PDE-3 [milrinone: the inotrope; two addresses: cardiomyocyte ↑ Ca2+ influx, vascular smooth muscle MLCK inhibition], PDE-4 [roflumilast: the airway-inflammation lane], PDE-5 [sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil, avanafil: the cGMP lane]); THE NONSPECIFIC PAIR — theophylline (the rarely-used methylxanthine) and dipyridamole (the platelet row's other member, per the printed footnote b); THE USE GRID — ED / pulmonary hypertension / BPH-tadalafil-only (PDE-5), severe COPD (PDE-4), COPD/asthma rarely used (theophylline), acute decompensated HF with cardiogenic shock (milrinone), intermittent claudication / stroke-or-TIA prevention / cardiac stress testing dipyridamole-only / stent-restenosis prevention (the platelet pair); THE CAUTION STRIP — 'hypotension in patients taking nitrates' (the nitrate interaction, printed as an adverse cell; the 24-48h separation protocol is KYP-flagged), cyanopia sildenafil-only via PDE-6 (six) in retina, ventricular arrhythmias under milrinone, depression/anxiety/insomnia under roflumilast, cardiotoxicity + neurotoxicity under theophylline; the reading-rule footer).
